summary.text: Michael Lemelin is a Republican member of the Maine House of Representatives from District 53 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A professional pilot and business owner, he lives in Chelsea, Maine.

paragraphs.text: Michael Lemelin lives in Chelsea, Maine.
His career experience includes owning a business, working as business manager of Chiro-Works, and working as a professional pilot.
He has served as chair of the Chelsea Planning Board and has been affiliated with the RSU 12 School Board and the Knights of Columbus.
Ballotpedia lists Lemelin's tenure in the Maine House as beginning in 2020, with the current District 53 seat assumed on December 6, 2022.
He was assigned to the Health and Human Services Committee in 2021-2022 and 2023-2024.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
